peakRssBytes.reason: 9 GB: five runs at 180 pages measured 3.30, 4.72 and 7.22 GB on an M-series Mac and 6.23 GB on CI's ubuntu runner (2026-10-22). Peak resident memory is mostly rolldown's native memory per module and moves by 4 GB between identical runs, so this catches gross growth only; held heap carries the per-page gate. origin/main locally: 6.48 GB.

peakRssBytesPerPage.reason: 48 MB: the same runs measured 0.05, 13.7 and 34.0 MB per page locally and 27.5 MB on CI between 60 and 180 pages, the spread of the peak above; origin/main locally: 26.9 MB.

retainedHeapBytes.reason: 800 MB: measured 732 and 733 MB held after a full collection at 180 pages; origin/main before: 843 MB.

retainedHeapBytesPerPage.reason: 3.3 MB: reading rendered chunks on worker threads measured 3.00 MB per page on CI between 60 and 180 pages against main's 2.62 MB, while the absolute held heap fell at every size (623 MB against main's 732 MB at 180 pages on CI). Main's parse cache is already full at 60 pages, so its fixed cost drops out of main's slope but not out of this one; the full 498-page ui.shadcn.com build peaks at the same memory as main (main 22 to 24 GB, this tree 21.9 to 24.5 GB, cold and warm, 2026-10-22). Each page compiles about 70 symbol modules of its own, which is what this grows with.

graphEndHeapBytes.reason: 768 MB: the heap held after a full collection at the end of an environment's module graph, before the compiles held for it are released, measured 591 MB (client) at 180 pages on an M-series Mac (2026-11-01). The phases above are all sampled after that release, so none of them saw compile results held twice.

largestClientChunkBytes.reason: 256 kB: measured 0.11 MB at 180 pages (origin/main the same); the runtime walls in fixture-builds gate framework weight, this catches a chunk that absorbs the site.

largestArtifactBytes.reason: 6 MB: measured 4.63 MB (interaction-closures.json) at 180 pages; origin/main before wrote a 22.6 MB execution-demand.json.

clientModules.reason: Client graph modules at 180 pages, measured 15,028 on main f79073248, 14,911 once #348 dropped the re-export wrappers, 4,495 once a source's symbols the pack planner treats alike ship as one module (CI, 2026-10-29), and 4,541 once the widgets call a helper module from their handlers (2026-11-01); the count is the same on every run, so the budget is the measurement. Rolldown spends about 90 KB of native memory per module whatever its size (#268), so a rise is a memory and time regression; lower it as module-cutting changes land.

clientModulesPerPage.reason: Client modules per extra page between 60 and 180 pages: (15,028 - 5,452) / 120 = 79.8 on main f79073248 (2026-10-28), 79.7 after #348 and 22.5 once symbols are grouped (CI, 2026-10-29), the same on every run. Each page adds its own symbol modules; this catches a change that multiplies them.

compiles.reason: Whole-module compiles the compile memo did not answer at 180 pages: 994 (2026-11-01, the same on every run). #401 compiled every module whose handler called an imported function a second time, even with no state passed: 1,062 here, and on the 498-page ui.shadcn.com port the client build went from fitting a 6,656 MB heap to running out of it. Each compile's result is held until buildEnd, so a rise is a memory regression.

buildCpuPerPageInReferenceRuns.reason: 0.5 runs of reference.mjs per extra page between 60 and 180 pages: five CI runs on one tree (2026-10-22) measured 441 to 784 ms per page, the runner speeds CI hands out, but 0.360 to 0.422 reference runs; an M-series Mac measured 0.387 lightly loaded but 0.517 to 0.556 with other builds running, where a developer runs this, so it gets 0.7. Main before the 2026-10 build-time fixes took 1.5 to 1.65 times this tree's per-page CPU, about 0.56 or more.

buildCpuGrowth.reason: 2.9x the build CPU for 3x the pages, a backstop for a step that grows faster than the page count: an M-series Mac measured 2.68x on this fixture (2.55x to 2.64x and the runner 2.26x on the earlier one); main before the 2026-10 build-time fixes took 3.05x.
